description: Wind Techno-economic Exclusions is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Energy Commission. The wind techno-economic exclusion layer has been updated for proposed use in the current 2026-2027 IRP cycle. The previous version was developed in 2023. Two changes are reflected in this current draft update: Low wind resource quality is defined by wind speeds less than 6.5 m/s according to Global Wind Atlas 100-meter hub height data. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Energy Commission. Its tags are Busbar Mapping, CAOpenData, California Natural Resources Agency, IRP, TPP. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
